name: why-cards
description: Centred heading over three linked use-case glass cards on a brand splash (indigo / teal orbs on white, fading out at the edges). Live: the .epx-why section on the solution pages, Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification and Help Desk (rules ported).

items.description: Cards. Each: title (line breaks kept) and body; optional url (links the title), link_label (with url: an arrow link under the body carries the url instead of the title), icon (image URL) or icon_svg (inline SVG), icon_alt.

variant.description: All variants: glass cards over the splash. solution: the six solution pages. readiness: deeper bottom space, still icons (Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification). service: shallow bottom space (Help Desk).

columns.description: 0: every card in one row (today's three-card band). 2 or 3: the cards wrap into a grid that many columns wide from 1001px (24px gaps; two columns from 641px, one below), for more than three cards, e.g. the Compare hub's six industry cards (Figma 7379:184440).
